bed_format: PLINK 1 SNP-major (6c 1b 01); 00=hom A1, 01=missing, 10=het, 11=hom A2; first sample in the low bits

admixed.notes: Two Balding-Nichols populations at Fst 0.10 plus six admixed founders and three nuclear families (within pop1, cross-population, within pop2). KING-robust and KING-homo diverge most here.

bigish.notes: 200 individuals: nuclear families, three-generation units, undeclared cross-family sibships and unrelated singletons. Performance and accumulation-order case.

dups.notes: Exact duplicate pair across two FIDs, an MZ-twin-like pair within one FID at a 0.2%% per-genotype error rate, one parent-offspring pair and four unrelated samples.

missing.notes: Nuclear family with per-sample missingness of 0/1/5/20/50%%, 300 high-missingness SNPs and 5 SNPs missing in every sample.

monomorphic.notes: Every tenth SNP cycles a category: ordinary, monomorphic with both alleles named, monomorphic with A1 written as PLINK's missing allele '0', MAF 0.001, MAF 0.001 with a forced singleton carrier, and MAF exactly 0.5.

multifam.notes: Four declared families plus undeclared cross-family relatives (PO, FS, avuncular, first cousins) so .kin0 carries real relatives, not only unrelated pairs.

nuclear.notes: Father, mother, four full sibs. Case/control phenotypes.

pair.notes: Exactly two individuals, in different FIDs, that are genetically full sibs through undeclared parents: .kin is empty and .kin0 holds one related pair.

sexchr.notes: Autosomes plus X (23), Y (24), XY (25) and MT (26). Both sexes plus sex-0 individuals. Haploid genotypes are emitted homozygous; Y is missing for non-males.

singleton.notes: Single individual: no pairs at all.

threegen.notes: Three generations. Contains PO, FS, half sibs (2nd), grandparent-grandchild (2nd), avuncular (2nd), half-avuncular (3rd) and first cousins (3rd).

trio.notes: Father, mother, one child. No missingness.

unrelated.notes: 30 mutually unrelated founders. Ten share one FID (so .kin is exercised with unrelated pairs), twenty are in their own FIDs (.kin0). Expected kinship 0 throughout.

genetic_map: bim column 3 in centimorgans at 1 cM per Mb
